mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.member_id AS memberId, m.name AS writerName, b.board_type AS boardType, b.insurance_type AS insuranceType, b.title AS title, b.content AS content, b.view_cnt AS viewCnt, b.status AS status, b.open_yn AS openYn, b.deleted_yn AS deletedYn, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ins_board b JOIN ins_member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId} AND b.deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE ins_board SET member_id = #{memberId}, board_type = #{boardType}, insurance_type = #{insuranceType}, status = #{status}, open_yn = #{openYn}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
UPDATE ins_board SET deleted_yn = 'Y', updated_at = NOW() WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
UPDATE ins_board SET view_cnt = view_cnt + 1 WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
UPDATE ins_board SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
